description: Group an array of primitives or objects by the value at a property path. Returns an array of { key, items } groups.
label: Array Group

options.name: path
options.label: Path
options.info: If the array contains objects, the dot-separated path to the property to group on. For example, 'user.name'

options.name: schemaModel
options.label: Schema Model
options.info: The schema model to use for the output type.

options.name: result
options.label: Output
options.info: An array of groups. Each group is an object: 'key' is the shared value at Path, 'items' is the array of matching items.
